purpose: Exploratory aggregate evidence only; not runtime estimation coefficients. See docs/claude-context-estimation-study.md.

population.scope: saved timer/structural conversation cohorts; all retained requests through fixed cutoff; read-only current catalog; per-conversation snapshots
population.family_policy: Root/helper families additionally unioned by duplicated native API response ID before splitting; original timer copy preferred, then SDK copy

method: ridge log1p target; family-equal training weights; alpha selected by family-weighted validation log error; independent validation aggregate mean correction; no true input/derived tool tokens in predictors; same held-out families for paired ablations; fixed-time disjoint-family stress test; exploratory repeated ablations

sensitivity.note: Exploratory sensitivity. Same fitting and fixed splits as first ablation. Subgroups use fits trained on full training partition, without refitting.

reproduction: Private scalar extracts and evaluator scripts retained under .context in the study workspace. Entity identities and transcript content are excluded from this aggregate report.
